name: DatenkranzOncology
title: genomDE KDK Oncology Datenkranz (logical model)
description: Logical model of the BfArM MV-GenomSeq KDK oncology submission (schemas/kdk/Oncology.json), generated by scripts/schema_to_logical.py; the source type of the genomDE FML StructureMaps. Element names are the JSON property names, so a raw Datenkranz JSON instance parses against it unchanged. Dates are kept as strings (copied verbatim), enumerations are strings whose allowed values are listed in each element definition.
